old: A 1914 5-centavo coin from Mexico. The front shows a liberty cap with rays and the words REPUBLICA MEXICANA and E. DE CHIHA. The back shows a large 5 pierced by an upright arrow, a centavo monogram, and the words EJERCITO CONSTITUCIONALISTA and 1914 (the engraver name SALAZAR, when present, appears on the front). Made of copper.
